A '''mission''' to [[Bevell Three]] was carried out in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] when [[Jai Raventhorn]] lead a four-man [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] team to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bevell Three]] to capture four [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agents. The mission was compromised and only Jai managed to escape. As a propaganda measure rather than a reward, Jai was promoted to [[Master Sergeant/Legends|Master Sergeant]].
